subway: Closed transfer station utility tunnel. Charcoal blue-grey, sparse purple trim, short top tunnel rails and a tiny muted red pipe. Turquoise mineral clusters.
red-gate: Snowy underground ice cavern with muted midnight blue slate, little stepped snow patches hugging the outer edges, frosty pale blue clusters. Quiet dark blue floor.
museum: Hidden museum service excavation. Oxidized teal framing, dark slate, a couple of simple crate silhouettes near the top entrance only. Bright green-turquoise mineral clusters.
cartenon: Carved ancient stone temple excavation. A small, simple slab arch at the top, gray-navy foundation and icy blue-white crystals.
demon-castle: Ash street excavation under a burnt stone arch. Dark umber floor, sparse charcoal stone edges and copper-red orange crystals.
jeju-hive: Narrow dark basalt ant-hive workshop. Chunky umber stone curb only, amber-gold mineral clusters. No eggs or creatures.
red-knight: Iron dungeon excavation. Dusty purple slate, sparse iron posts in chunky blocks, deep rose and garnet-red mineral clusters.
